scope: Static review of repo-owned non-Compact Rust Relation/Circuit implementations and artifact adapters. Tracked plus unignored Rust source inventory; no builds, proof runs or exploit construction. Historical experimental relations are distinct from current reference Compact account.
inventoryCommand: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard *.rs; source search for impl Relation / impl Circuit, including generic impls

rows.pointBoundary: Typed P256 public or private key assigned via backend curve.assign[_as_public_input]; scalar-field assignment; explicit nonzero r,s and computed verification point; bit-based MSM and x-coordinate reduction equality.
rows.limitations: No explicit local nonidentity assertion on public key; validity/identity semantics depend on backend assignment. PrivatePk proves possession for some private key, without account commitment or enrolled-key membership. WebAuthn variant receives client-data hash and does not itself bind browser origin/challenge. Existing tests cover valid/wrong keys, r/s zero and high-s; not a complete malicious-point witness audit.

rows.pointBoundary: Backend P256 public-key assignment and shared ecdsa_assert_valid; in-circuit fixed ceremony prefix, base64url challenge, RP ID, flags and both SHA256 layers.
rows.limitations: Same key-validity/backend dependency as other P256 relations; this experiment is not the current reference wa-json134 implementation. No new proof or malformed-point test run performed for this inventory.

rows.pointBoundary: Canonical compressed byte and subgroup gadgets for public A and private R; s<L check; SHA512 and cofactorless equation. Host decompression also demands subgroup membership.
rows.limitations: No explicit nonidentity A/R guard; identity is in the subgroup. Host malformed decompression uses expect and can panic; host rejection alone is not evidence of malicious-witness constraint soundness. Do not describe this primitive as enforcing a live device key.

rows.pointBoundary: Typed JubjubSubgroup public key assigned by backend; scalar assignment, computed R and Poseidon challenge byte equality.
rows.limitations: No explicit nonidentity public-key guard. This historical upstream-style Poseidon/minus-sign signature differs from Passport custom SHA256/grinding signing; neither interoperability nor current-reference gate guarantees follow from its tests.

rows.pointBoundary: No user ECC public key; secret byte packing and hash equality statements.
rows.limitations: Hash-preimage relations, not ECC signer-key validation. Any curve use through proof verification is backend functionality.

rows.pointBoundary: Recursively verifies inner proof and exposes accumulator/inner statement. verify_wrapped checks outer proof, inner verifying-key transcript binding, resolvable fixed-base labels, and native deferred accumulator pairing.
rows.limitations: Outer proof verification alone is insufficient; callers must preserve verify_wrapped native checks. Does not add application key enrollment or nonidentity policies to wrapped inner statement. Existing wrapper tests include test-only AltSameShapeInner for VK-binding checks.

rows.pointBoundary: Typed secp256k1 witness key assigned by backend and bound to public x bytes with even y; scalar s assignment; in-circuit SHA256 tagged challenge; explicitly nonidentity reconstructed R with even y and canonical x=r bytes. Host lift_x_even uses RustCrypto verifying-key parser.
rows.limitations: No explicit local nonidentity assertion on key itself; identity handling depends on backend assignment/coordinate constraints, not host lift alone. Host helper rejects invalid x, but a custom prover need not use host helper. Source review only; no new malformed-point proof run.

rows.pointBoundary: Test-only relations for wrapper-key binding and original platform ECC characterization.
rows.limitations: Deliberately narrow test statements; not shipped authentication circuits. Counts exclude these from reusable experimental relations.

rows.pointBoundary: Despite filename, circuits.rs executes onchain VM queries and computes challenges/signatures. Adjacent files load/prove generated Compact ZKIR; no repo-owned Relation/Circuit implementation here.
rows.limitations: Covered as client/artifact adapter; do not double-count as separately authored constraint system.

remainingWork: Pin and independently test malformed/identity witnesses for historical relations before claiming their live-key enforcement. This source inventory is not an audit of external proof backend gadgets or arbitrary prover advice.
